answer.headline: Manchester-Boston Regional (MHT) trailing-twelve-month seat factor is {F1}; the latest month is {F2}.
answer.body: Manchester binds to Manchester-Boston Regional Airport (MHT) in New Hampshire, the only exact city match. Over the latest trailing twelve months of departing passenger and combi segments, calculated seat factor (passengers divided by seats) is {F1}. The latest available month is {F2}. Within that window the highest month is {F5} and the lowest is {F12}. A linear fit of the monthly series has slope {F15} per month. That slope is descriptive and includes seasonality, so it does not establish a structural decline. Seat factor is a calculated ratio. It is not a measure of unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, or profitability.
